verdict.rationale: An official desktop app exists: Kimi Code Desktop opens local project folders and lets the agent read, edit and run code through conversation. However, nothing in the evidence shows global OS-level shortcuts or any ability to see or capture what is on the user's screen, and the app appears scoped to coding rather than general assistant use. Missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-content access or screen capture, a general-purpose desktop assistant app, independent hands-on corroboration.
